sources.entry: BatchSet - Remove image backgrounds with AI right in your browser, then convert, compress or resize whole folders at once. Free without signup. #freemium

summary.name: BatchSet AI Background Remover
summary.one_liner: A browser-based AI tool that automatically removes backgrounds from product, people and pet photos and exports transparent PNG cut-outs.
use_cases: Clean white-background product listings for Shopify, Daraz, Amazon, Etsy
Ad creatives and social media graphics
Thumbnails for YouTube and blog posts
Batch removing backgrounds from a folder of photos
summary.what_it_does: Uses an AI segmentation model to detect the main subject of a photo (products, people or pets) and erase the background automatically, with no manual masking. Standard mode runs in the browser and the original image stays on the user's device. HD mode uses the BiRefNet model on BatchSet's server for finer edges such as hair and fur, and requires credits and a Pro or Enterprise plan. Output is a transparent PNG, which can also be composited onto white, black or a custom background colour. Bulk mode processes a whole batch and downloads the cut-outs as a ZIP.
notable: Standard mode runs on-device in the browser, so the original image is never uploaded
HD mode uses the BiRefNet model for hair and fine-edge detail
Bulk batch processing with ZIP download
Part of a wider BatchSet toolkit that includes convert, resize and QR/barcode tools
caveats: HD mode costs 100 credits per image and is only available on Pro and Enterprise plans
Signed-in Standard removals use 1 credit each; bulk batches run from an account using credits
Free tier keeps no file backup of cut-outs
Input limits differ between page sections: 10 MB in the upload box, 25 MB in the steps text
